arxiv-2107-03539.title: An extremal subharmonic function in non-archimedean potential theory
arxiv-2107-03539.creator: Małgorzata Stawiska
arxiv-2107-03539.description: Abstract . We define an analog of the Leja-Siciak-Zaharjuta subharmonic extremal function for a proper subset E E of the Berkovich projective line 𝖯 1 \mathsf{P}^{1} over a field with a non-archimedean absolute value, relative to a point ζ ∉ E \zeta\not\in E .

arxiv-2111-09859.title: On the use of high order central difference schemes for differential equation based wall distance computations
arxiv-2111-09859.creator: Hemanth Chandra Vamsi Kakumani a \text{Hemanth Chandra Vamsi Kakumani}^{a}, Nagabhushana Rao Vadlamani a , \text{Nagabhushana Rao Vadlamani}^{a,}, Paul Gary Tucker b \text{Paul Gary Tucker}^{b}
arxiv-2111-09859.description: Abstract A computationally efficient high-order solver is developed to compute the wall distances by solving the relevant partial differential equations, namely: Eikonal, Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) and Poisson equations. In contrast to the upwind schemes widely used in the literature, we explore the suitability of high-order central difference schemes (explicit/compact) for the wall-distance computation.

arxiv-2206-13020.title: Quantum control and quantum speed limits in supersymmetric potentials
arxiv-2206-13020.creator: C. Campbell, J. Li, Th. Busch, T. Fogarty
arxiv-2206-13020.description: Abstract Supersymmetry allows one to build a hierarchy of Hamiltonians that share the same spectral properties and which are pairwise connected through common super-potentials. The iso-spectral properties of these Hamiltonians imply that the dynamics and therefore control of different eigenstates are connected through supersymmetric intertwining relations.

arxiv-2208-06068.title: Energy conservation of weak solutions for the incompressible Euler equations via vorticity
arxiv-2208-06068.creator: Jitao Liu, Yanqing Wang, and Yulin Ye
arxiv-2208-06068.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jitao Liu, Yanqing Wang, and Yulin Ye. Motivated by the works of Cheskidov, Lopes Filho, Nussenzveig Lopes and Shvydkoy in [ 8 , Commun. 348: 129-143, 2016] and Chen and Yu in [ 5 , J. 131: 1-16, 2019] , we address how the L p L^{p} control of vorticity could influence the energy conservation for the incompressible homogeneous and nonhomogeneous Euler equations in this paper.

arxiv-2302-11647.title: Patient stratification in multi-arm trials: a two-stage procedure with Bayesian profile regression
arxiv-2302-11647.creator: Yuejia Xu 1,∗, Angela M. Wood 2,3, and Brian D. M. Tom 1 1 MRC Biostatistics Unit, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, U.K 2 Cardiovascular Epidemiology Unit, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, U.K 3 NIHR Blood and Transplant Research Unit in Donor Health and Genomics, Cambridge, U.K
arxiv-2302-11647.description: Abstract Precision medicine is an emerging field that takes into account individual heterogeneity to inform better clinical practice. In clinical trials, the evaluation of treatment effect heterogeneity is an important component, and recently, many statistical methods have been proposed for stratifying patients into different subgroups based on such heterogeneity.

arxiv-2307-14502.title: The Effect of Spoken Language on Speech Enhancement using Self-Supervised Speech Representation Loss Functions
arxiv-2307-14502.description: Abstract Recent work in the field of speech enhancement (SE) has involved the use of self-supervised speech representations (SSSRs) as feature transformations in loss functions. However, in prior work, very little attention has been paid to the relationship between the language of the audio used to train the self-supervised representation and that used to train the SE system.

arxiv-2312-14863.title: GENERALIZED t-EDGE DISTANCE-BALANCED GRAPHS Thanks: MSC(2010): Primary: 05C12; Secondary: 05C25, Keywords: generalized t t -edge distance-balanced graphs, graph products, edge-szeged index, complete bipartite graphs ∗ * Corresponding author
arxiv-2312-14863.creator: Z. Aliannejadi ∗ , M. Alaeiyan, A. Gilani
arxiv-2312-14863.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Z. Aliannejadi ∗ , M. Alaeiyan, A. Gilani. A connected and nonempty graph A A is defined as generalized t t -edge distance-balanced, while for each edge f = α ​ β f=\alpha\beta the number of edges nearer to α \alpha than β \beta are equal to t t -times of edges nearer to β \beta than to α \alpha , for t ∈ ℕ t\in\mathbb{N} , or vice versa. We determine some classes of such graphs.

arxiv-2402-07023.title: Gemini Goes to Med School: Exploring the Capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models on Medical Challenge Problems & Hallucinations
arxiv-2402-07023.creator: Ankit Pal, Malaikannan Sankarasubbu
arxiv-2402-07023.description: Abstract Large language models have the potential to be valuable in the healthcare industry, but it’s crucial to verify their safety and effectiveness through rigorous evaluation. For this purpose, we comprehensively evaluated both open-source LLMs and Google’s new multimodal LLM called Gemini across Medical reasoning, hallucination detection, and Medical Visual Question Answering tasks.

arxiv-2403-08971.title: Designing a Data Science simulation with ℳ ​ ℰ ​ ℛ ​ ℐ ​ 𝒯 ​ 𝒮 \mathcal{MERITS} : A Primer
arxiv-2403-08971.creator: Corrine F. Elliott, James P.C. Duncan, Tiffany M. Tang, Merle Behr, Karl Kumbier, and Bin Yu, Department of Statistics, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA, Graduate Group in Biostatistics, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Statistics, University of Michigan, MI, USA
arxiv-2403-08971.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Corrine F. Elliott, James P.C. Duncan, Tiffany M. Tang, Merle Behr, Karl Kumbier, and Bin Yu, Department of Statistics, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA, Graduate Group in Biostatistics, University of California, Berkeley, CA, USA, Department of Statistics, University of Michigan, MI, USA. Simulations play a crucial role in the modern scientific process. Yet despite (or due to) this ubiquity, the Data Science community shares neither a comprehensive definition for a “high-quality” study nor a consolidated guide to designing one.

arxiv-2406-05403.title: SemPat: Using Hyperproperty-based Semantic Analysis to Generate Microarchitectural Attack Patterns
arxiv-2406-05403.creator: Adwait Godbole (🖂) {}^{\text{(\Letter)}}, Yatin A. Manerkar, Sanjit A. Seshia
arxiv-2406-05403.description: Abstract . Microarchitectural security verification of software has seen the emergence of two broad classes of approaches. The first is based on semantic security properties (e.g., non-interference) which are verified for a given program and a specified abstract model of the hardware microarchitecture.

arxiv-2502-09248.title: Sequential Covariance Fitting for InSAR Phase Linking
arxiv-2502-09248.creator: Dana EL HAJJAR, Guillaume GINOLHAC, Yajing YAN, and Mohammed Nabil EL KORSO
arxiv-2502-09248.description: Abstract Traditional Phase-Linking algorithms are known for their high cost, especially with the huge volume of Synthetic Aperture Radar images generated by Sentinel- 1 1 Synthetic Aperture Radar missions. Recently, a COvariance Fitting Interferometric Phase Linking approach has been proposed, which can be seen as a generic framework for existing Phase-Linking methods.

arxiv-2509-03775.title: ContraGS: Co debook- Con densed and Tra inable G aussian S platting for Fast, Memory-Efficient Reconstruction
arxiv-2509-03775.creator: Sankeerth Durvasula, Sharanshangar Muhunthan, Zain Moustafa, Richard Chen, Ruofan Liang, Yushi Guan, Nilesh Ahuja, Nilesh Jain, Selvakumar Panneer, Nandita Vijaykumar
arxiv-2509-03775.description: Abstract 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a state-of-art technique to model real-world scenes with high quality and real-time rendering. Typically, a higher quality representation can be achieved by using a large number of 3D Gaussians. However, using large 3D Gaussian counts significantly increases the GPU device memory for storing model parameters.

arxiv-2510-27555.title: On the global existence and uniform-in-time bounds for three-component reaction-diffusion systems with mass control and polynomial growth Journal: Journal of Differential Equations
arxiv-2510-27555.creator: Redouane Douaifia a,b , Salem Abdelmalek c , Mokhtar Kirane d,∗
arxiv-2510-27555.description: Abstract We investigate a class of three-component reaction–diffusion systems subject to mass control and a newly introduced structural assumption, referred to as linear intermediate weighted sum condition. Under these hypotheses, we establish the global existence of classical solutions in arbitrary spatial dimensions and wide class of boundary conditions, even when the nonlinearities exhibit arbitrary polynomial growth.

arxiv-2511-08193.title: A Compact Dual-Beam Zeeman Slower for High-Flux Cold Atoms
arxiv-2511-08193.creator: Chen Chen, Kejun Liu, Dezhou Deng, Shuchang Ma, Peng Zhu, Zhichang He, J. F. Chen, Xiaoxiao Wu, Peng Chen
arxiv-2511-08193.description: Abstract We present a compact design of dual-beam Zeeman slower optimized for efficient production of cold atom applications. Traditional single-beam configurations face challenges from substantial residual atomic flux impacting downstream optical windows, resulting in increased system size, atomic deposition contamination, and a reduced operational lifetime.

arxiv-2511-16936.title: Shape-preserving Tooth Segmentation from CBCT Images Using Deep Learning with Semantic and Shape Awareness
arxiv-2511-16936.creator: Zongrui Ji, Zhiming Cui, Na Li, Qianhan Zheng, Miaojing Shi, Ke Deng, Jingyang Zhang, Chaoyuan Li, Xuepeng Chen, Yi Dong, Lei Ma
arxiv-2511-16936.description: Abstract Background: Accurate tooth segmentation from cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) images is crucial for digital dentistry but remains challenging in cases of interdental adhesions, which cause severe anatomical shape distortion. Methods: To address this, we propose a deep learning framework that integrates semantic and shape awareness for shape-preserving segmentation.

arxiv-2601-10475.title: Positive Damping Region: A Graphic Tool for Passivization Analysis with Passivity Index
arxiv-2601-10475.creator: Xiaoyu Peng, Xi Ru, Zhongze Li, Jianxin Zhang, Xinghua Chen, Feng Liu
arxiv-2601-10475.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyu Peng, Xi Ru, Zhongze Li, Jianxin Zhang, Xinghua Chen, Feng Liu. This paper presents a geometric framework for analyzing output-feedback and input-feedforward passivization of linear time-invariant systems. We reveal that a system is passivizable with a given passivity index when the Nyquist plot for SISO systems or the Rayleigh quotient of the transfer function for MIMO systems lies within a specific, index-dependent region in the complex plane, termed the positive damping region.

arxiv-2601-13139.title: From Human to Machine Refactoring: Assessing GPT-4’s Impact on Python Class Quality and Readability
arxiv-2601-13139.creator: Alessandro Midolo, Emiliano Tramontana, Massimiliano Di Penta
arxiv-2601-13139.description: Abstract . Refactoring is a software engineering practice that aims to improve code quality without altering program behavior. Although automated refactoring tools have been extensively studied, their practical applicability remains limited. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have introduced new opportunities for automated code refactoring.

frus-1945-50-intel-d288.source: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

pmc-10550224.title: Recurring volcanic winters during the latest Cretaceous: Sulfur and fluorine budgets of Deccan Traps lavas
pmc-10550224.creator: Sara Callegaro, Don R. Baker, Paul R. Renne, Leone Melluso, Kalotina Geraki, Martin J. Whitehouse, Angelo De Min, Andrea Marzoli
pmc-10550224.description: Two events share the stage as main drivers of the Cretaceous-Paleogene mass extinction—Deccan Traps volcanism, and an asteroid impact recorded by the Chicxulub crater. We contribute to refining knowledge of the volcanic stressor by providing sulfur and fluorine budgets of Deccan lavas from the Western Ghats (India), which straddle the Cretaceous-Paleogene boundary.

pmc-10652375.title: Conductometric Flexible CuO-Based Sweat-Loss Monitoring Sensor for Future Wearable Technology in Healthcare
pmc-10652375.creator: Rasit Aydin, Osman Kahveci, Abdullah Akkaya, Bünyamin Şahin, Enise Ayyıldız
pmc-10652375.description: Healthcare tracking supports early diagnosis of illnesses, real-time tracking of the impacts of therapy and treatment, and tracking of cases of human health. Based on this, real-time tracking of sweat loss provides an easy, convenient, and noninvasive approach to the early diagnosis of physical illness in individuals.

pmc-11336076.title: Utilizing radiomics for differential diagnosis of inverted papilloma and chronic rhinosinusitis with polyps based on unenhanced CT scans
pmc-11336076.creator: Shaojuan He, Yuxuan Zhao, Lei Shi, Xiaorong Yang, Xuehai Wang, Yang Luo, Mingming Wang, Xianxing Zhang, Xuezhong Li, Dexin Yu, Xin Feng
pmc-11336076.description: To evaluate whether radiomics models based on unenhanced paranasal sinuses CT images could be a useful tool for differentiating inverted papilloma (IP) from chronic rhinosinusitis with polyps (CRSwNP). This retrospective study recruited 240 patients with CRSwNP and 106 patients with IP from three centers.

pmc-11368400.title: Future movement plans interact in sequential arm movements
pmc-11368400.creator: Mehrdad Kashefi, Sasha Reschechtko, Giacomo Ariani, Mahdiyar Shahbazi, Alice Tan, Jörn Diedrichsen, J Andrew Pruszynski, Juan Alvaro Gallego, Mehrdad Kashefi, Sasha Reschechtko, Giacomo Ariani, Mahdiyar Shahbazi, Alice Tan, Jörn Diedrichsen, J Andrew Pruszynski
pmc-11368400.description: Real-world actions often comprise a series of movements that cannot be entirely planned before initiation. When these actions are executed rapidly, the planning of multiple future movements needs to occur simultaneously with the ongoing action. How the brain solves this task remains unknown.

pmc-11654431.title: Trends and changes in the relationship between quality and price in tenders for healthcare services in the Israeli health system, 2013–2023
pmc-11654431.creator: Adi Niv-Yagoda, Hadar Goldshtein
pmc-11654431.description: Background and objectivesPublic healthcare systems face constraints in financial and professional resources. The Mandatory Tenders Law 5752 − 1992 stipulates that before entering into a contract for the supply of a service or product, public authorities and government corporations must undergo a public tender process.

pmc-11760404.title: Comparative Evaluation of Plaque Removal Potential of Manual Electrical and Chewable Toothbrushes in Children: A Clinical Trial
pmc-11760404.creator: Ajay R Mareddy, Venugopal N Reddy, Vasanthi Done, Tarannum Rehaman, Trisha Gadekar, Swetha Prakash Ammula
pmc-11760404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Aim and backgroundTo evaluate and compare the efficiency of a manual, electrical, and chewable toothbrush for plaque removal in children.Materials and methodsA total of 58 children aged 8–14 years who reported to the Department of Pedodontics. The children and guardians were familiarized with the disclosing agent, manual toothbrush, electrical toothbrush, and chewable toothbrush before the commencement of the study with the help of video and verbal demonstrations.

pmc-12381316.title: A bibliometric analysis of trends and hotspots in autophagy in gastric cancer
pmc-12381316.creator: Jianfang Zhu, Liuyang Shu
pmc-12381316.description: BackgroundAutophagy plays a critical role in the biology of gastric cancer (GC), influencing tumor progression, drug resistance, and treatment outcomes. This study aims to analyze the bibliometric landscape of autophagy research in GC, identifying key contributors, influential publications, and emerging research themes.

pmc-12443126.title: Promising treatment biomarkers in asthma
pmc-12443126.creator: Barbara Bonnesen, Jens-Ulrik S. Jensen, Alexander G. Mathioudakis, Alexandru Corlateanu, Pradeesh Sivapalan
pmc-12443126.description: Asthma is a highly heterogenous disease which researchers over time have attempted to classify into different phenotypes and endotypes to improve diagnosis, prognosis and treatment. Earlier classifications based on reaction to environmental allergens, age, sex and lung function have evolved, and today, the use of precision medicine guided by biomarkers offers new perspectives on asthma management.

pmc-13284612.title: Comprehensive mapping of identical sequences across human proteins emphasizes the widespread issue of shared epitopes in self-antigens
pmc-13284612.creator: Guillaume Kellermann, Olivier Croce, Baharia Mograbi, Paul Hofman, Patrick Brest

pmc-13563706.title: Microglia-specific NLRP3 inhibition mitigates hippocampal neuroinflammation and cognitive deficits after hemorrhagic shock with resuscitation
pmc-13563706.creator: Ya-Mei Zhang, Meng-Yue Wang, Zhong-Yong Zhang, Xin-Yu Yang, Hong-Lian Duan, Jian-Kai Sun, Xiao-Yi Ma, Rong-Xin Song, Jing-Yu Hui, Dong-Xue Zhang, Li-Min Zhang, Hui-Tao Miao
pmc-13563706.description: BackgroundCognitive dysfunction is a prevalent mental health problem following hemorrhagic shock with resuscitation (HSR). Our previous work indicated that neuroinflammation caused by nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3), which is modulated by glial cells, such as microglia, is potentially significant in developing emotional and cognitive dysfunction.

pmc-13601871.title: Video and App-Based Games for Youth Emotion Regulation: Scoping Review
pmc-13601871.creator: Angela May Ashley, Jaidyn Kataryna Charlton, Hannah Wayne-Phillips, Aislin R Mushquash, Christine Wekerle
pmc-13601871.description: BackgroundEmotion regulation (ER) is a transdiagnostic construct encompassing distinct strategies that can be used to encourage adaptive coping skills in support of youth’s (ages 10 to 24 years) mental health. ER is responsive to training and intervention, such as via video and app-based games.

pmc-13658275.title: Diagnostic challenge of pulmonary embolism during testosterone replacement therapy for primary hypogonadism
pmc-13658275.creator: Hamza El Hadi, Silke Dorothea Hölscher, Jonel Trebicka, Elena Vorona
pmc-13658275.description: Testosterone replacement therapy (TRT) is widely used in the management of male hypogonadism to restore physiological androgen levels and improve related symptoms. Although generally considered safe under appropriate monitoring, its association with pulmonary embolism (PE) remains controversial. We report a case of a 50-year-old man who independently and progressively shortened testosterone injection intervals due to recurrent hypogonadal symptoms.

round-the-moon.title: Round the Moon
round-the-moon.creator: Verne, Jules
round-the-moon.description: Jules Verne's classic tale begun in "From the Earth to the Moon" continues in this worthy sequel.
